subject: general
question: Let ΔABC ~ ΔQPR and (Area of ΔABC) : (Area of ΔPQR) = 121 : 64. If QP = 14.4 cm, PR = 12 cm and AC = 18 cm, then what is the length of AB?
solution:
**Given:**

(Area of ΔABC) : (Area of ΔPQR) = 121 : 64

QP = 14.4 cm

PR = 12 cm

AC = 18 cm

**Concept used:**

If, ΔXYZ∼ΔPTR,

then (XY²)/(PT²) =(YZ²)/(TR²) = (XZ²)/(PR²) = (Area of Delta XYZ)/(Area of Delta PTR)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/832d49aee596d1acd77b7d558f47f94b33f3d596de778c02c9550ff610c7d828.png] 

As ΔABC ~ ΔQPR

So, AB²/QP² = 121/64

⇒ AB/QP = 11/8

⇒ AB/14.4 = 11/8

⇒ 8AB = 11 × 14.4

⇒ AB = (11 × 14.4)/8

⇒ AB = 19.8 cm

**∴ The length of AB is 19.8 cm.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**Here we do not need to work on the values of other sides as in the question only AB is asked.
